title: Tokoh Dunia Sepanjang Sejarah
subtitle: Kelahiran, kehidupan, dan kematian di atas bola dunia

people.name: Jesus of Nazareth
people.short_biography: Central figure of Christianity and a major prophet in Islam. His life and teachings fundamentally shaped Western civilization and the modern calendar.

people.name: Paul the Apostle
people.short_biography: Early Christian apostle who spread the teachings of Jesus across the Greco-Roman world and wrote pivotal epistles of the New Testament.

people.name: Nero
people.short_biography: Fifth Roman emperor whose reign is infamous for tyranny, extravagant debauchery, and the Great Fire of Rome.

people.name: Pliny the Elder

birth_location.region_name: Novum Comum, Roman Empire (present-day Como, Italy)

death_location.region_name: Stabiae, Roman Empire (present-day Castellammare di Stabia, Italy)

people.short_biography: Roman author, naturalist, and military commander who wrote the monumental encyclopedia Naturalis Historia.

people.name: Cai Lun

birth_location.region_name: Leiyang, Hunan, Eastern Han Dynasty (present-day China)

people.short_biography: Chinese court eunuch credited with inventing the modern papermaking process, transforming global record-keeping.

people.name: Trajan
people.short_biography: Roman emperor under whose rule the Roman Empire reached its maximum territorial extent.
